#Requires -Version 5.1
<#
.SYNOPSIS
    WmiExecutor.psm1 - Module thuc thi benign WMI read-only component cho NT230 PoC.
.DESCRIPTION
    Module cung cap function Invoke-PocWmiComponent theo schema_version 1.1,
    tuong thich voi PowerShellExecutor.psm1 de Telemetry Collector dung chung parser.

    Component thuc hien:
      1. Query Win32_OperatingSystem (thong tin OS)
      2. Query Win32_Process cua tien trinh PowerShell hien tai (PID, ParentProcessId, CreationDate)
      3. Lay process inventory (top N theo MaxProcesses)
      4. Tao memory marker va validate marker

    Marker chi ton tai trong bo nho (fileless benign), khong ghi ra disk.
.NOTES
    Project  : NT230
    Scenario : FILELESS-WMI-001
    Schema   : 1.1
#>

Set-StrictMode -Version Latest

# =============================================================================
# Private helpers
# =============================================================================

function ConvertTo-Iso8601WithOffset {
    <#
    .SYNOPSIS
        Convert WMI datetime sang ISO 8601 string co offset (DateTimeOffset).
    .DESCRIPTION
        Get-CimInstance tra ve datetime duoi dang DateTime object (Kind=Local),
        nhung mot so truong hop (Get-WmiObject hoac property raw) co the tra ve
        DMTF string dang "yyyyMMddHHmmss.ffffff+UUU". Function nay xu ly ca
        DateTime, DateTimeOffset, DMTF string va ISO 8601 string, luon tra ve
        chuoi ISO 8601 co offset (vd: 2026-11-08T15:27:24.5230556+07:00).

        Neu khong the convert, tra ve $null - khong bao gio fallback sang string
        local time khong offset (de tranh telemetry correlation sai).
    .PARAMETER Value
        Gia tri datetime can convert (DateTime, DateTimeOffset, hoac DMTF string).
    .OUTPUTS
        String ISO 8601 co offset, hoac $null neu input null/invalid.
    #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $false)][object]$Value
    )

    if ($null -eq $Value) { return $null }

    # Truong hop 1: DateTimeOffset - goi ToString('o') truc tiep.
    if ($Value -is [System.DateTimeOffset]) {
        return $Value.ToString('o')
    }

    # Truong hop 2: DateTime - convert sang DateTimeOffset giu Kind.
    if ($Value -is [System.DateTime]) {
        if ($Value.Kind -eq [System.DateTimeKind]::Utc) {
            return (New-Object System.DateTimeOffset($Value, [System.TimeSpan]::Zero)).ToString('o')
        }
        # Local hoac Unspecified - dung offset cua local timezone.
        $localOffset = [System.TimeZoneInfo]::Local.GetUtcOffset($Value)
        return (New-Object System.DateTimeOffset($Value, $localOffset)).ToString('o')
    }

    # Truong hop 3: String - co the la DMTF (WMI raw) hoac ISO 8601.
    if ($Value -is [string]) {
        if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($Value)) { return $null }

        # 3a: Thu parse ISO 8601 truoc (ly tuong nhat).
        try {
            $parsed = [System.DateTimeOffset]::Parse(
                $Value,
                [System.Globalization.CultureInfo]::InvariantCulture,
                [System.Globalization.DateTimeStyles]::AssumeLocal
            )
            return $parsed.ToString('o')
        }
        catch {
            # Khong phai ISO 8601 - thu DMTF.
        }

        # 3b: DMTF string (vd: "20261107160308.593498+420").
        try {
            $dt = [System.Management.ManagementDateTimeConverter]::ToDateTime($Value)
            if ($null -ne $dt) {
                $localOffset = [System.TimeZoneInfo]::Local.GetUtcOffset($dt)
                return (New-Object System.DateTimeOffset($dt, $localOffset)).ToString('o')
            }
        }
        catch {
            return $null
        }
    }

    return $null
}

function New-MemoryMarker {
    <#
    .SYNOPSIS
        Tao marker trong bo nho (script scope) cho PoC.
    .DESCRIPTION
        Marker la PSCustomObject luu trong session state variable.
        Day la ky thuat fileless benign - khong ghi ra disk.
    #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][ValidateNotNullOrEmpty()][string]$RunId,
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][ValidateNotNullOrEmpty()][string]$ScenarioId,
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][ValidateNotNullOrEmpty()][string]$VariantId,
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][ValidateNotNullOrEmpty()][string]$Component
    )

    $marker = [PSCustomObject][ordered]@{
        name           = 'NT230_FILELESS_POC'
        marker_version = '1.1'
        project        = 'NT230'
        run_id         = $RunId
        scenario_id    = $ScenarioId
        variant_id     = $VariantId
        component      = $Component
        execution_type = 'benign'
        storage        = 'memory'
        created_at     = [System.DateTimeOffset]::Now.ToString('o')
        host           = $env:COMPUTERNAME
        status         = 'initialized'
    }

    # Luu marker vao script-scope variable de validate lai sau.
    $varName = 'NT230_FILELESS_POC_MARKER_' + $RunId
    Set-Variable -Name $varName -Value $marker -Scope Script

    return $marker
}

function Test-MemoryMarker {
    <#
    .SYNOPSIS
        Validate marker co ton tai trong bo nho va co dung run_id khong.
    .OUTPUTS
        PSCustomObject voi cac truong: marker_name, storage, status, run_id,
        variable_exists, run_id_match, marker_version, validation_time.
    #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][ValidateNotNullOrEmpty()][string]$RunId
    )

    $varName = 'NT230_FILELESS_POC_MARKER_' + $RunId

    $validation = [PSCustomObject][ordered]@{
        marker_name      = 'NT230_FILELESS_POC'
        storage          = 'memory'
        status           = 'NOT_VALIDATED'
        run_id           = $RunId
        variable_exists  = $false
        run_id_match     = $false
        marker_version   = $null
        validation_time  = [System.DateTimeOffset]::Now.ToString('o')
    }

    try {
        $markerVar = Get-Variable -Name $varName -Scope Script -ErrorAction Stop
        if ($null -ne $markerVar.Value) {
            $validation.variable_exists = $true
            if ([string]$markerVar.Value.run_id -eq $RunId) {
                $validation.run_id_match   = $true
                $validation.marker_version = [string]$markerVar.Value.marker_version
                $validation.status         = 'VALID'
            }
            else {
                $validation.status = 'RUN_ID_MISMATCH'
            }
        }
        else {
            $validation.status = 'MARKER_NULL'
        }
    }
    catch {
        $validation.status = 'VARIABLE_NOT_FOUND'
    }

    return $validation
}

function Get-ProcessInventory {
    <#
    .SYNOPSIS
        Lay danh sach N tien trinh dang chay (process inventory).
    .DESCRIPTION
        Sap xep theo ProcessId va lay top N de co danh sach on dinh giua cac lan chay.
    #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][ValidateRange(1, 10)][int]$MaxProcesses
    )

    $inventory = @()

    try {
        $processes = Get-CimInstance -ClassName Win32_Process `
            -Property Name, ProcessId, ParentProcessId, CreationDate, CommandLine `
            -ErrorAction Stop

        $topProcesses = $processes | Sort-Object ProcessId | Select-Object -First $MaxProcesses

        foreach ($p in $topProcesses) {
            $creationDate = ConvertTo-Iso8601WithOffset -Value $p.CreationDate

            $inventory += [PSCustomObject][ordered]@{
                name           = $p.Name
                pid            = [int]$p.ProcessId
                parent_pid     = [int]$p.ParentProcessId
                creation_date  = $creationDate
                command_line   = $p.CommandLine
            }
        }
    }
    catch {
        # Inventory co the trong neu WMI khong truy cap duoc.
        Write-Warning ('[WMI_EXECUTOR] PROCESS_INVENTORY_ERROR={0}' -f $_.Exception.Message)
    }

    return $inventory
}

# Public function (entry point cua module)

function Invoke-PocWmiComponent {
    <#
    .SYNOPSIS
        Thuc thi benign WMI read-only component cho PoC.
    .DESCRIPTION
        Component thuc hien cac query WMI chi doc (read-only) va tao memory marker.
        Tra ve execution result theo schema_version 1.1, tuong thich voi
        PowerShellExecutor.psm1 de Telemetry Collector dung chung parser.

        Buoc thuc thi:
          1. Query Win32_OperatingSystem (Caption, Version, BuildNumber, CSName, LastBootUpTime)
          2. Query Win32_Process cua tien trinh PowerShell hien tai
             (Name, ProcessId, ParentProcessId, CreationDate, CommandLine)
          3. Lay process inventory (top N theo MaxProcesses)
          4. Tao memory marker va validate marker

        Marker chi ton tai trong bo nho (fileless benign), khong ghi ra disk.
    .PARAMETER RunId
        Dinh danh duy nhat cua lan chay (do controller cap).
    .PARAMETER ScenarioId
        Ma kich ban (vd: FILELESS-WMI-001).
    .PARAMETER VariantId
        Ma bien the (vd: V01).
    .PARAMETER MaxProcesses
        So luong tien trinh toi da de lay trong inventory (1-10).
    .OUTPUTS
        PSCustomObject theo schema_version 1.1, gom:
        schema_version, run_id, scenario_id, variant_id, component, operation,
        start_time, end_time, duration_ms, status, process, marker,
        marker_validation, result, errors, error_message.
    #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][ValidateNotNullOrEmpty()][string]$RunId,
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][ValidateNotNullOrEmpty()][string]$ScenarioId,
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][ValidateNotNullOrEmpty()][string]$VariantId,
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][ValidateRange(1, 10)][int]$MaxProcesses
    )

    $component = 'wmi_executor'
    $operation = 'wmi_readonly_inventory'
    $startTime = [System.DateTimeOffset]::Now
    $errors    = @()

    $osInfo             = $null
    $processInfo        = $null
    $processInventory   = @()
    $marker             = $null
    $markerValidation   = $null

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Query 1: Win32_OperatingSystem
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    try {
        $os = Get-CimInstance -ClassName Win32_OperatingSystem `
            -Property Caption, Version, BuildNumber, CSName, LastBootUpTime `
            -ErrorAction Stop

        $lastBoot = ConvertTo-Iso8601WithOffset -Value $os.LastBootUpTime

        $osInfo = [PSCustomObject][ordered]@{
            caption       = $os.Caption
            version       = $os.Version
            build_number  = $os.BuildNumber
            computer      = $os.CSName
            last_boot_up  = $lastBoot
        }
    }
    catch {
        $errors += ('OS_QUERY: ' + $_.Exception.Message)
    }

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Query 2: Win32_Process cua tien trinh PowerShell hien tai
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    try {
        $proc = Get-CimInstance -ClassName Win32_Process `
            -Filter "ProcessId = $PID" `
            -Property Name, ProcessId, ParentProcessId, CreationDate, CommandLine `
            -ErrorAction Stop

        if ($null -eq $proc) {
            throw 'Cannot find current PowerShell process via WMI.'
        }

        $creationDate = ConvertTo-Iso8601WithOffset -Value $proc.CreationDate

        $processInfo = [PSCustomObject][ordered]@{
            name              = $proc.Name
            pid               = [int]$proc.ProcessId
            parent_pid        = [int]$proc.ParentProcessId
            creation_date     = $creationDate
            command_line      = $proc.CommandLine
            parent_pid_source = 'wmi_win32_process'
        }
    }
    catch {
        $errors += ('PROCESS_QUERY: ' + $_.Exception.Message)
    }

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Query 3: Process inventory (top N theo MaxProcesses)
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    $processInventory = Get-ProcessInventory -MaxProcesses $MaxProcesses

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Marker: tao trong bo nho + validate
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    try {
        $marker = New-MemoryMarker `
            -RunId $RunId `
            -ScenarioId $ScenarioId `
            -VariantId $VariantId `
            -Component $component

        $marker.status = 'running'

        $markerValidation = Test-MemoryMarker -RunId $RunId

        if ($markerValidation.status -eq 'VALID') {
            $marker.status = 'completed'
        }
        else {
            $marker.status = 'partial'
            $errors += ('MARKER_VALIDATION: ' + $markerValidation.status)
        }
    }
    catch {
        $errors += ('MARKER: ' + $_.Exception.Message)
    }

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Tinh toan thoi gian va status
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    $endTime    = [System.DateTimeOffset]::Now
    $durationMs = [int]([System.Math]::Round(($endTime - $startTime).TotalMilliseconds))

    $status = 'FAILED'

        operation           = $operation
        os                  = $osInfo
        process             = $processInfo
        process_count       = [int]$processInventory.Count
        process_inventory   = $processInventory
    }

        name              = 'NT230_FILELESS_POC'

        run_id            = $RunId

        variant_id        = $VariantId
        component         = $component
        operation         = $operation
        start_time        = $startTime.ToString('o')

        status            = $status
        process           = $processInfo
        marker            = $markerRecord
        marker_validation = $markerValidation
        result            = $result
        errors            = $errors
        error_message     = if ($errors.Count -gt 0) { $errors -join '; ' } else { $null }
    }
}
